programme.title: Operator (2015)
programme.desc: Michael Kelly is the lead park ranger at a state park. Mostly dealing with rowdy campers, Kelly and his other rangers are suddenly thrown into grave danger as they're forced to face off against an 18-foot, man-eating grizzly bear! With an apathetic mayor who's afraid to close the park, Kelly and the other rangers must stop the bear before it kills again!

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Indiana Regional 2025, watch a thrilling collegiate pickleball battle between Purdue University and Creighton University. Tied at 2-2 entering the broadcast, this match features intense mixed doubles action that decides the series.Key matchups include Purdue’s Emma Jones and Jay Barath facing off against Creighton’s Russell Lee and Lucy. Later, Purdue’s Caleb Young and Tammy Lamb take on Creighton’s Noah Wodzinski and Elizabeth Cook.

programme.title: Operator (2015)
programme.desc: Michael Kelly is the lead park ranger at a state park. Mostly dealing with rowdy campers, Kelly and his other rangers are suddenly thrown into grave danger as they're forced to face off against an 18-foot, man-eating grizzly bear! With an apathetic mayor who's afraid to close the park, Kelly and the other rangers must stop the bear before it kills again!

programme.title: IncrediTales
programme.desc: Jenny and her best friend Blam the Teddy Bear run a magic shop in the town of Dreamville, where everybody can come for magical help. The residents of Dreamville always leave the shop thanking Jenny, but actually, they set the stage for their own miracles, leaving behind in the shop whatever is keeping them from living life and making decisions. After all, the ability to change yourself is the truest form of magic. Jenny and Blam never refuse to help anyone, but it often happens that they’re the ones who need help, since Jenny’s still a kid and Blam’s an eccentric teddy bear.

The residents of Dreamville always leave the shop thanking Jenny, but actually, they set the stage for their own miracles, leaving behind in the shop whatever is keeping them from living life and making decisions. After all, the ability to change yourself is the truest form of magic. Jenny and Blam never refuse to help anyone, but it often happens that they’re the ones who need help, since Jenny’s still a kid and Blam’s an eccentric teddy bear.

The residents of Dreamville always leave the shop thanking Jenny, but actually, they set the stage for their own miracles, leaving behind in the shop whatever is keeping them from living life and making decisions. After all, the ability to change yourself is the truest form of magic. Jenny and Blam never refuse to help anyone, but it often happens that they’re the ones who need help, since Jenny’s still a kid and Blam’s an eccentric teddy bear.

The residents of Dreamville always leave the shop thanking Jenny, but actually, they set the stage for their own miracles, leaving behind in the shop whatever is keeping them from living life and making decisions. After all, the ability to change yourself is the truest form of magic. Jenny and Blam never refuse to help anyone, but it often happens that they’re the ones who need help, since Jenny’s still a kid and Blam’s an eccentric teddy bear.

The residents of Dreamville always leave the shop thanking Jenny, but actually, they set the stage for their own miracles, leaving behind in the shop whatever is keeping them from living life and making decisions. After all, the ability to change yourself is the truest form of magic. Jenny and Blam never refuse to help anyone, but it often happens that they’re the ones who need help, since Jenny’s still a kid and Blam’s an eccentric teddy bear.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Heily García, de 23 años y madre de cuatro hijos, fue asesinada en Cali en 2017. Su amiga Mayra Alejandra Ramírez, tras perder a su propio bebé, fingió estar embarazada y asesinó a Heily para quedarse con su recién nacida, Luciana, a quien luego abandonó. La bebé fue hallada con vida días después. Mayra se entregó meses después y fue condenada a 20 años de prisión.

La bebé fue hallada con vida días después. Mayra se entregó meses después y fue condenada a 20 años de prisión.
